(ns mithril.native-js
  "Checked inert Mithril source with explicit host imports and native JS values.
   This backend preserves host call/iterator/closure semantics; it has no guest
   word ABI or runtime fuel ledger and is not the restricted Amu guest profile."
  (:require [clojure.string :as str]
            [mithril.form :as form]
            [mithril.module :as module]))

(def ^:private reserved
  #{"await" "break" "case" "catch" "class" "const" "continue" "debugger"
    "default" "delete" "do" "else" "enum" "export" "extends" "false" "finally"
    "for" "function" "if" "implements" "import" "in" "instanceof" "interface"
    "let" "new" "null" "package" "private" "protected" "public" "return"
    "static" "super" "switch" "this" "throw" "true" "try" "typeof" "var"
    "void" "while" "with" "yield" "arguments" "eval"})
(defn- fail! [code detail]
  (throw (ex-info detail {:mithril/error code :detail detail})))
(defn- shape! [value fields]
  (when-not (and (map? value) (= (set fields) (set (keys value))))
    (fail! :mithril.native-js/shape "Unexpected or missing native JS module fields")))
(defn- optional-flag! [value required flag]
  (shape! value (if (contains? value flag) (conj (vec required) flag) required))
  (when (and (contains? value flag) (not (boolean? (get value flag))))
    (fail! :mithril.native-js/shape "Optional native declaration flags must be boolean")))
(defn- vector! [value bound]
  (when-not (vector? value) (fail! :mithril.native-js/shape "Expected a vector"))
  (when (> (count value) bound)
    (fail! :mithril.native-js/budget "Native JS source collection exceeds its budget")))
(defn- name! [name]
  (when-not (and (string? name) (re-matches #"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*" name))
    (fail! :mithril.native-js/name "Invalid native JS identifier"))
  name)
(defn- unique! [names]
  (when-not (= (count names) (count (set names)))
    (fail! :mithril.native-js/duplicate "Duplicate native JS declaration")))
(defn- params! [params]
  (vector! params 64)
  (let [names (mapv (fn [p]
                     (shape! p (if (contains? p "default") ["name" "datatype" "default"] ["name" "datatype"]))
                     (when-not (= "js-value" (get p "datatype"))
                       (fail! :mithril.native-js/type "Native JS parameters use js-value"))
                     (name! (get p "name"))) params)]
    (unique! names) names))
(defn- literal! [value]
  (when-not (or (nil? value) (string? value) (boolean? value)
                (and (number? value) (js/Number.isFinite value)))
    (fail! :mithril.native-js/literal "Native literals must be finite JSON primitives"))
  value)
(defn- pattern! [p]
  (if (string? p)
    {:op :name :names [(name! p)]}
    (do (shape! p ["array"])
        (let [names (get p "array")]
          (vector! names 64)
          {:op :array :names (mapv name! names)}))))

(defn- expression! [expr imports functions locals depth nodes args-length]
  (when (or (> depth 64) (> (swap! nodes inc) 4096))
    (fail! :mithril.native-js/budget "Native JS expression budget exceeded"))
  (when-not (map? expr) (fail! :mithril.native-js/shape "Expected a native expression"))
  (let [check #(expression! % imports functions locals (inc depth) nodes args-length)
        args! (fn [args]
                (vector! args 64)
                (mapv check args))]
    (case (get expr "@type")
      "Literal"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "datatype" "value"])
          (when-not (= "js-value" (get expr "datatype"))
            (fail! :mithril.native-js/type "Native literals use js-value"))
          {:op :literal :value (literal! (get expr "value"))})
      "Local"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "name"])
          (let [name (name! (get expr "name"))]
            (when-not (contains? locals name)
              (fail! :mithril.native-js/local "Unknown native JS local"))
            {:op :local :name name}))
      "HostImport"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "name"])
          (let [name (name! (get expr "name"))]
            (when-not (contains? imports name)
              (fail! :mithril.native-js/import "Undeclared host import"))
            {:op :import :name name}))
      "FunctionRef"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "name"])
          (let [name (name! (get expr "name"))]
            (when-not (contains? functions name)
              (fail! :mithril.native-js/function "Unknown native function"))
            {:op :function-ref :name name}))
      "Call"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "name" "args"])
          (let [name (name! (get expr "name")) args (args! (get expr "args"))]
            (when-not (contains? functions name)
              (fail! :mithril.native-js/function "Unknown native function"))
            ;; Native calls keep JS missing/extra argument behavior. Runtime
            ;; function values are neither inspected nor prevalidated.
            {:op :call :name name :args args}))
      "HostGet"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "object" "key"])
          {:op :get :object (check (get expr "object")) :key (check (get expr "key"))})
      "HostInvoke"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "function" "args"])
          {:op :invoke :function (check (get expr "function")) :args (args! (get expr "args"))})
      "HostMethod"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "object" "key" "args"])
          {:op :method :object (check (get expr "object")) :key (check (get expr "key"))
           :args (args! (get expr "args"))})
      "HostUndefined"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type"]) {:op :undefined})
      "HostArgumentsLength"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type"])
          (when-not args-length
            (fail! :mithril.native-js/scope "HostArgumentsLength requires a source normal function context"))
          {:op :arguments-length})
      "HostUnary"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "operator" "value"])
          (let [operator (get expr "operator")]
            (when-not (contains? #{"!" "typeof"} operator)
              (fail! :mithril.native-js/operator "Unsupported native unary operator"))
            {:op :unary :operator operator :value (check (get expr "value"))}))
      "HostBinary"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "operator" "left" "right"])
          (let [operator (get expr "operator")]
            (when-not (contains? #{"===" "!==" ">=" "in" "instanceof" "+" "-" "%" "<"} operator)
              (fail! :mithril.native-js/operator "Unsupported native binary operator"))
            {:op :binary :operator operator :left (check (get expr "left"))
             :right (check (get expr "right"))}))
      "HostConstruct"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "constructor" "args"])
          {:op :construct :constructor (check (get expr "constructor"))
           :args (args! (get expr "args"))})
      "HostArrayItems"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "items"])
          (let [items (get expr "items")]
            (vector! items 4096)
            {:op :array-items :items (mapv (fn [item]
                                            (cond
                                              (and (map? item) (= #{"value"} (set (keys item))))
                                              {:kind :value :value (check (get item "value"))}
                                              (and (map? item) (= #{"spread"} (set (keys item))))
                                              {:kind :spread :value (check (get item "spread"))}
                                              :else (fail! :mithril.native-js/shape
                                                            "HostArrayItems entries need exactly value or spread"))) items)}))
      "HostOptionalMethod"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "object" "key" "args"])
          {:op :optional-method :object (check (get expr "object")) :key (check (get expr "key"))
           :args (args! (get expr "args"))})
      "HostLogical"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "operator" "left" "right"])
          (let [operator (get expr "operator")]
            (when-not (contains? #{"&&" "||" "??"} operator)
              (fail! :mithril.native-js/operator "Unsupported native logical operator"))
            {:op :logical :operator operator :left (check (get expr "left"))
             :right (check (get expr "right"))}))
      "HostObject"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "entries"])
          (let [entries (get expr "entries")]
            (vector! entries 4096)
            {:op :object :entries (mapv (fn [entry]
                                         (optional-flag! entry ["key" "value"] "infer_name")
                                         (let [value (check (get entry "value"))]
                                           (when (and (contains? entry "infer_name") (not= :lambda (:op value)))
                                             (fail! :mithril.native-js/shape "Name inference requires a NativeLambda initializer"))
                                           {:key (check (get entry "key"))
                                            :value (cond-> value (true? (get entry "infer_name"))
                                                     (assoc :infer-name true))})) entries)}))
      "HostSpread"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "value"])
          {:op :spread :value (check (get expr "value"))})
      "HostSet"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "object" "key" "value"])
          {:op :set :object (check (get expr "object")) :key (check (get expr "key"))
           :value (check (get expr "value"))})
      "HostForOf"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "iterable" "binding" "body" "result"])
          (let [binding (name! (get expr "binding"))]
            (when (contains? locals binding)
              (fail! :mithril.native-js/duplicate "Loop binding must be fresh"))
            {:op :for-of :binding binding :iterable (check (get expr "iterable"))
             :body (expression! (get expr "body") imports functions (assoc locals binding false)
                                (inc depth) nodes args-length)
             :result (check (get expr "result"))}))
      "HostArray"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "items"])
          (let [items (get expr "items")]
            (vector! items 4096) {:op :array :items (mapv check items)}))
      "NativeLambda"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "params" "body"])
          (let [params (get expr "params")]
            (vector! params 64)
            (let [patterns (mapv pattern! params)
                  names (vec (mapcat :names patterns))]
              (unique! names)
              {:op :lambda :params patterns
               :body (expression! (get expr "body") imports functions
                                  (into locals (zipmap names (repeat false))) (inc depth) nodes args-length)})))
      "Let"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "bindings" "body"])
          (let [bindings (get expr "bindings")]
            (vector! bindings 4096)
            (loop [todo (seq bindings) env locals checked []]
              (if-let [binding (first todo)]
                (do (optional-flag! binding ["name" "value"] "mutable")
                    (let [name (name! (get binding "name"))
                          value (expression! (get binding "value") imports functions env (inc depth) nodes args-length)
                          checked-binding (cond-> {:name name :value value}
                                            (contains? binding "mutable") (assoc :mutable (get binding "mutable")))]
                      (recur (next todo) (assoc env name (true? (get binding "mutable")))
                             (conj checked checked-binding))))
                {:op :let :bindings checked
                 :body (expression! (get expr "body") imports functions env (inc depth) nodes args-length)}))))
      "LocalSet"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "name" "value"])
          (let [name (name! (get expr "name"))]
            (when-not (true? (get locals name))
              (fail! :mithril.native-js/local "LocalSet requires an explicitly mutable local"))
            {:op :local-set :name name :value (check (get expr "value"))}))
      "HostThrow"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "value"])
          {:op :throw :value (check (get expr "value"))})
      "HostTryFinally"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "body" "finally"])
          {:op :try-finally :body (check (get expr "body")) :finally (check (get expr "finally"))})
      "LocalFunction"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "name" "params" "body" "result"])
          (let [name (name! (get expr "name")) params (get expr "params")]
            (when (contains? reserved name)
              (fail! :mithril.native-js/name "Reserved native local function name"))
            (when (contains? locals name)
              (fail! :mithril.native-js/duplicate "LocalFunction binding must be fresh"))
            (vector! params 64)
            (let [params (mapv name! params) _ (unique! params)
                  self-env (assoc locals name false)
                  body-env (into self-env (zipmap params (repeat false)))]
              {:op :local-function :name name :params params
               :body (expression! (get expr "body") imports functions body-env (inc depth) nodes true)
               :result (expression! (get expr "result") imports functions self-env (inc depth) nodes args-length)})))
      "Sequence"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "expressions"])
          (let [expressions (get expr "expressions")]
            (vector! expressions 4096)
            (when (empty? expressions) (fail! :mithril.native-js/shape "Sequence requires a result"))
            {:op :sequence :expressions (mapv check expressions)}))
      "If"
      (do (shape! expr ["@type" "condition" "then" "else"])
          {:op :if :condition (check (get expr "condition"))
           :then (check (get expr "then")) :else (check (get expr "else"))})
      (fail! :mithril.native-js/expression "Unsupported native JS expression"))))

(defn check-document
  "Check a separate native JS context; imports are an explicit host capability list."
  [doc]
  (shape! doc (cond-> ["@context" "@type" "name" "imports" "functions" "exports"]
                (contains? doc "bindings") (conj "bindings")))
  (when-not (and (= "NativeJsModule" (get doc "@type"))
                (= "https://mithril.fund/context/native-js-module/v1" (get doc "@context")))
    (fail! :mithril.native-js/context "Expected the native JS module context"))
  (let [name (get doc "name") imports (get doc "imports")
        functions (get doc "functions") exports (get doc "exports")]
    (when-not (and (string? name) (re-matches #"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*(?:\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)*" name))
      (fail! :mithril.native-js/name "Invalid native JS module name"))
    (vector! imports 128) (vector! functions 128) (vector! exports 128)
    (doseq [import imports] (name! import)) (unique! imports)
    (let [declarations (mapv (fn [f]
                              (shape! f ["@type" "name" "params" "returns" "body"])
                              (when-not (and (= "Function" (get f "@type"))
                                            (= "js-value" (get f "returns")))
                                (fail! :mithril.native-js/type "Expected a js-value native function"))
                              (let [name (name! (get f "name"))]
                                (when (contains? reserved name)
                                  (fail! :mithril.native-js/name "Reserved native JS function name"))
                                {:name name :params (params! (get f "params"))})) functions)
          names (mapv :name declarations)
          _ (unique! names)
          targets (set names)
          public (mapv (fn [e]
                         (let [e (if (string? e) {"name" e "function" e} e)]
                           (shape! e ["name" "function"])
                           (let [name (name! (get e "name")) target (name! (get e "function"))]
                             (when-not (contains? targets target)
                               (fail! :mithril.native-js/export "Unknown native JS export"))
                             {:name name :target target}))) exports)
          _ (unique! (mapv :name public)) nodes (atom 0)]
      (let [bindings (if (contains? doc "bindings") (get doc "bindings") [])
            _ (vector! bindings 128)
            binding-names (mapv (fn [b]
                                  (optional-flag! b ["name" "value"] "mutable")
                                  (name! (get b "name"))) bindings)
            _ (unique! binding-names)
            _ (when (some (into (set imports) targets) binding-names)
                (fail! :mithril.native-js/duplicate "Module bindings must be disjoint from imports/functions"))
            checked-bindings (loop [todo (seq bindings) env {} checked []]
                               (if-let [b (first todo)]
                                 (let [name (get b "name")
                                       ;; Initializers can use earlier bindings, never functions.
                                       value (expression! (get b "value") (set imports) #{} env 1 nodes false)
                                       cb (cond-> {:name name :value value}
                                            (contains? b "mutable") (assoc :mutable (get b "mutable")))]
                                   (recur (next todo) (assoc env name (true? (get b "mutable"))) (conj checked cb)))
                                 {:env env :bindings checked}))
            module-env (:env checked-bindings)
            checked-functions
            (mapv (fn [f d]
                    (let [env (into module-env (zipmap (:params d) (repeat false)))
                          defaults (into {} (keep-indexed
                                             (fn [i p]
                                               (when (contains? p "default")
                                                 [i (expression! (get p "default") (set imports) targets env 1 nodes true)]))
                                             (get f "params")))]
                      (cond-> (assoc d :body (expression! (get f "body") (set imports) targets env 1 nodes true))
                        (seq defaults) (assoc :defaults defaults)))) functions declarations)]
        (cond-> {:format :mithril.native-js/checked-v1 :name name :imports imports :exports public
                 :functions checked-functions}
          (contains? doc "bindings") (assoc :bindings (:bindings checked-bindings)))))))

(defn check-text [text]
  (module/check-source-text! text)
  (check-document (form/parse text)))
(defn- quoted [s] (js/JSON.stringify s))
(defn- fresh [counter prefix] (str prefix "v" (swap! counter inc)))

(defn- emit-expression [expr imports functions env counter prefix args-length]
  (let [emit #(emit-expression % imports functions env counter prefix args-length)
        args #(str/join "," (map emit %))]
    (case (:op expr)
      :literal (quoted (:value expr))
      :local (get env (:name expr))
      :import (get imports (:name expr))
      :function-ref (get functions (:name expr))
      :call (str (get functions (:name expr)) "(" (args (:args expr)) ")")
      :get (str "(" (emit (:object expr)) ")[" (emit (:key expr)) "]")
      ;; The comma expression makes a value call, never a Reference call with
      ;; an accidental receiver (e.g. when the callee is a HostGet).
      :invoke (str "(0," (emit (:function expr)) ")(" (args (:args expr)) ")")
      :method (str "(" (emit (:object expr)) ")[" (emit (:key expr)) "](" (args (:args expr)) ")")
      :undefined "(void 0)"
      :arguments-length "arguments.length"
      :unary (str "(" (:operator expr) " " (emit (:value expr)) ")")
      :binary (str "(" (emit (:left expr))
                   (if (contains? #{"in" "instanceof" "+" "-" "%" "<"} (:operator expr))
                     (str " " (:operator expr) " ") (:operator expr))
                   (emit (:right expr)) ")")
      :logical (str "(" (emit (:left expr)) (:operator expr) (emit (:right expr)) ")")
      ;; Computed properties avoid the special object-literal __proto__ setter.
      :object (str "({" (str/join "," (map #(str "[" (emit (:key %)) "]:" (emit (:value %)))
                                          (:entries expr))) "})")
      :spread (str "({..." (emit (:value expr)) "})")
      :set (str "((" (emit (:object expr)) ")[" (emit (:key expr)) "]=" (emit (:value expr)) ")")
      :for-of (let [symbol (fresh counter prefix)
                    body-env (assoc env (:binding expr) symbol)]
                ;; Native for-of supplies IteratorClose and lexical iteration scope.
                (str "(()=>{for(const " symbol " of " (emit (:iterable expr)) "){"
                     (emit-expression (:body expr) imports functions body-env counter prefix args-length)
                     ";}return " (emit (:result expr)) ";})()"))
      :array (str "[" (args (:items expr)) "]")
      :construct (str "new (" (emit (:constructor expr)) ")(" (args (:args expr)) ")")
      :array-items (str "[" (str/join "," (map (fn [item]
                                                 (if (= :spread (:kind item))
                                                   (str "..." (emit (:value item)))
                                                   (emit (:value item)))) (:items expr))) "]")
      :optional-method (str "(" (emit (:object expr)) ")?.[" (emit (:key expr)) "](" (args (:args expr)) ")")
      :lambda (let [patterns (:params expr)
                    names (vec (mapcat :names patterns))
                    symbols (mapv (fn [_] (fresh counter prefix)) names)
                    env (into env (map vector names symbols))
                    pattern-source (map (fn [p]
                                          (let [s (map #(get env %) (:names p))]
                                            (if (= :array (:op p)) (str "[" (str/join "," s) "]") (first s)))) patterns)]
                ;; Always anonymous, including Let initializers; native arrow
                ;; arity, nonconstructibility and iterator binding are retained.
                (str (if (:infer-name expr) "((" "(0,((")
                     (str/join "," pattern-source) ")=>"
                     (emit-expression (:body expr) imports functions env counter prefix args-length)
                     (if (:infer-name expr) ")" "))")))
      :let (loop [todo (:bindings expr) env env statements []]
             (if-let [b (first todo)]
               (let [value (emit-expression (:value b) imports functions env counter prefix args-length)
                     symbol (fresh counter prefix)]
                 (recur (next todo) (assoc env (:name b) symbol)
                        (conj statements (str (if (:mutable b) "let " "const ") symbol "=" value ";"))))
               (str "(()=>{" (apply str statements) "return "
                    (emit-expression (:body expr) imports functions env counter prefix args-length) ";})()")))
      :local-set (str "(" (get env (:name expr)) "=" (emit (:value expr)) ")")
      :throw (str "(()=>{throw " (emit (:value expr)) ";})()")
      :try-finally (str "(()=>{try{return " (emit (:body expr)) ";}finally{"
                        (emit (:finally expr)) ";}})()")
      :local-function (let [symbol (fresh counter prefix)
                            self-env (assoc env (:name expr) symbol)
                            params (mapv (fn [_] (fresh counter prefix)) (:params expr))
                            body-env (into self-env (zipmap (:params expr) params))]
                        (str "(()=>{const " symbol "=function " (:name expr) "(" (str/join "," params) "){return "
                             (emit-expression (:body expr) imports functions body-env counter prefix true)
                             ";};return " (emit-expression (:result expr) imports functions self-env counter prefix args-length) ";})()"))
      :sequence (str "(" (args (:expressions expr)) ")")
      :if (str "(" (emit (:condition expr)) "?" (emit (:then expr)) ":" (emit (:else expr)) ")"))))

(defn- emit-checked [checked]
  (let [named-functions (concat (:functions checked)
                                (filter #(and (map? %) (= :local-function (:op %)))
                                        (tree-seq coll? seq checked)))
        prefix (loop [p "__mithril_native_"]
                 (if (some #(str/starts-with? (:name %) p) named-functions)
                   (recur (str p "_")) p))
        counter (atom 0) grants (str prefix "grants")
        imports (into {} (map #(vector % (str grants "[" (quoted %) "]")) (:imports checked)))
        functions (zipmap (map :name (:functions checked)) (map #(str prefix "f" %) (range)))
        module-bindings (loop [todo (:bindings checked) env {} statements []]
                          (if-let [b (first todo)]
                            (let [value (emit-expression (:value b) imports functions env counter prefix false)
                                  symbol (fresh counter prefix)]
                              (recur (next todo) (assoc env (:name b) symbol)
                                     (conj statements (str (if (:mutable b) "let " "const ") symbol "=" value ";\n"))))
                            {:env env :source (apply str statements)}))
        source (str "// Mithril native JS host module; explicit grants; native runtime semantics.\n"
                    "export function instantiateMithrilNative(" grants "){\n"
                    "if(" grants "===null||typeof " grants "!=='object')throw new Error('host-grant-mismatch');\n"
                    "const " prefix "keys=Reflect.ownKeys(" grants ");\n"
                    "if(" prefix "keys.length!==" (count (:imports checked)) "||"
                    prefix "keys.some(k=>!" (quoted (clj->js (:imports checked))) ".includes(k)))throw new Error('host-grant-mismatch');\n"
                    (:source module-bindings)
                    (apply str
                      (map (fn [f]
                             (let [params (mapv (fn [_] (fresh counter prefix)) (:params f))
                                   env (into (:env module-bindings) (zipmap (:params f) params))
                                   param-source (map-indexed
                                                  (fn [i symbol]
                                                    (if (contains? (:defaults f) i)
                                                      (str symbol "=" (emit-expression (get (:defaults f) i) imports functions env counter prefix true))
                                                      symbol)) params)]
                               (str "const " (get functions (:name f)) "=function " (:name f) "(" (str/join "," param-source) "){return "
                                    (emit-expression (:body f) imports functions env counter prefix true) ";};\n"))) (:functions checked)))
                    "return {" (str/join "," (map #(str "[" (quoted (:name %)) "]:" (get functions (:target %))) (:exports checked))) "};\n}\n")]
    {:format :mithril.native-js/artifact-v1 :module (:name checked)
     :required-imports (:imports checked) :exports (mapv :name (:exports checked))
     :runtime :native-js :source source}))

(defn- fail! [code detail]
  (throw (ex-info detail {:mithril/error code :detail detail})))

(defn source? [text]
  (str/starts-with? (str/triml (or text "")) "("))

(defn- key-name [k]
  (when-not (keyword? k)
    (fail! :mithril.form/non-keyword-field "Mithril form fields must be keywords"))
  (or (get key-names k)
      (when-not (namespace k) (name k))
      (fail! :mithril.form/unknown-field (str "unknown namespaced field: " k))))

(declare lower-form)

(defn- lower-value [value]
  (cond
    (list? value) (lower-form value)
    (vector? value) (mapv lower-value value)
    (or (string? value) (integer? value) (boolean? value) (nil? value)) value
    :else (fail! :mithril.form/unsupported-value
                 (str "unsupported Mithril form value: " (pr-str value)))))

;; IRI-coerced terms whose values may also be integer or boolean literals
;; (sh:targetNode 7, sh:in [1 2], sh:hasValue true) are lowered as plain
;; native values: org-w3-json-ld-api ef6a81a coerces only STRINGS under
;; "@type" "@id" (JSON-LD 1.1 §5.3.2), so 7 expands to the literal it is.
;; (Earlier pins made it a relative IRI and the Form wrapped such values in
;; explicit value objects; the RDF -- and so every graph digest -- is the
;; same either way at this pin, checked by form_test.)

(defn- fields [xs]
  (when (odd? (count xs))
    (fail! :mithril.form/field-arity "Mithril forms require keyword/value pairs"))
  (let [pairs (partition 2 xs)
        names (map (comp key-name first) pairs)]
    (when-not (= (count names) (count (set names)))
      (fail! :mithril.form/duplicate-field "Mithril form fields must be unique"))
    (into {} (map (fn [[k v]]
                    [(key-name k) (lower-value v)])
                  pairs))))

(def ^:private path-tags
  "SHACL property path sub-syntax (SHACL §2.3.1). Positional, not keyword
  pairs: each argument is an IRI string or another path form."
  {'path/sequence nil
   'path/alternative "shAlternativePath"
   'path/inverse "shInversePath"
   'path/zero-or-more "shZeroOrMorePath"
   'path/one-or-more "shOneOrMorePath"
   'path/zero-or-one "shZeroOrOnePath"})

(def ^:private not-owl2-rl-types
  "OWL terms Mithril refuses to express: its ontologies declare the OWL 2 RL
  profile, and these are outside it."
  #{"owl:ReflexiveProperty" "http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#ReflexiveProperty"})

(defn- lower-path [p]
  (cond
    (string? p) {"@id" p}
    (and (list? p) (contains? path-tags (first p))) (lower-form p)
    :else (fail! :mithril.form/invalid-path
                 (str "a path is an IRI string or a path/... form: " (pr-str p)))))

(defn- lower-path-form [[tag & args]]
  (let [n (count args)]
    (if (contains? #{'path/sequence 'path/alternative} tag)
      (when (< n 2)
        (fail! :mithril.form/path-arity (str tag " takes at least two paths")))
      (when-not (= 1 n)
        (fail! :mithril.form/path-arity (str tag " takes exactly one path"))))
    (cond
      (= 'path/sequence tag) {"@list" (mapv lower-path args)}
      (= 'path/alternative tag) {"shAlternativePath" (mapv lower-path args)}
      :else {(get path-tags tag) (lower-path (first args))})))

(defn- lower-literal
  "(rdf/literal \"lexical\" [:datatype \"xsd:date\" | :language \"en\"]) -> a
  JSON-LD value object: for typed or language-tagged literals, which bare
  Form values (strings, integers, booleans) cannot state."
  [[_ lexical & opts]]
  (when-not (string? lexical)
    (fail! :mithril.form/invalid-literal "rdf/literal takes a lexical string first"))
  (when (odd? (count opts))
    (fail! :mithril.form/field-arity "rdf/literal options are keyword/value pairs"))
  (let [{:keys [datatype language] :as o} (apply hash-map opts)]
    (when-not (every? #{:datatype :language} (keys o))
      (fail! :mithril.form/unknown-field "rdf/literal accepts only :datatype or :language"))
    (when (and datatype language)
      (fail! :mithril.form/invalid-literal "a literal has a datatype or a language, not both"))
    (when-not (every? #(or (nil? %) (string? %)) [datatype language])
      (fail! :mithril.form/invalid-literal "rdf/literal :datatype / :language are strings"))
    (cond-> {"@value" lexical}
      datatype (assoc "@type" datatype)
      language (assoc "@language" language))))

(defn- merge-type
  "A typed tag's own type first, then any :rdf/type the body adds."
  [tag-type body-type]
  (let [extra (cond (nil? body-type) [] (vector? body-type) body-type :else [body-type])
        types (vec (distinct (cons tag-type extra)))]
    (if (= 1 (count types)) (first types) types)))

(declare lower-tagged)

(defn lower-form [form]
  (when-not (and (list? form) (symbol? (first form)))
    (fail! :mithril.form/invalid-form "Mithril source must be one tagged S-expression"))
  (cond
    (contains? path-tags (first form)) (lower-path-form form)
    (= 'rdf/literal (first form)) (lower-literal form)
    :else (lower-tagged form)))

(defn- lower-tagged [form]
  (let [tag (first form)
        body (fields (rest form))
        types (let [t (get body "@type")] (if (vector? t) t [t]))]
    (when-let [bad (some not-owl2-rl-types types)]
      (fail! :mithril.form/not-owl2-rl
             (str bad " is outside the OWL 2 RL profile Mithril ontologies declare")))
    (cond
      (contains? top-level-tags tag)
      (assoc body "@context" (cond
                                (= tag 'mithril/growth-decision)
                                "https://mithril.fund/context/growth-decision/v1"
                                (= tag 'mithril/jev-decision)
                                "https://mithril.fund/context/jev-decision/v2"
                                (= tag 'mithril/bot-checkpoint-semantic)
                                "https://mithril.fund/context/bot-checkpoint/v1"
                                (= tag 'mithril/twin-document)
                                "https://mithril.fund/context/twin/v1"
                                (= tag 'mithril/module)
                                "https://mithril.fund/context/module/v1"
                                (= tag 'mithril/native-js-module)
                                "https://mithril.fund/context/native-js-module/v1"
                                :else "https://mithril.fund/context/v1")
                  "@type" (get top-level-tags tag))

      (= 'mithril/task tag)
      (cond-> (-> body (dissoc "@id") (assoc "id" (get body "@id")))
        (contains? body "toolProfileDigest")
        (dissoc "toolProfileDigest")
        (contains? body "toolProfileDigest")
        (assoc "tool-profile-digest" (get body "toolProfileDigest")))

      (contains? nested-tags tag) body

      (contains? typed-node-tags tag)
      (assoc body "@type" (merge-type (get typed-node-tags tag) (get body "@type")))

      :else (fail! :mithril.form/unknown-tag (str "unknown Mithril form tag: " tag)))))

(defn parse
  "Read exactly one inert Mithril form and lower it to the JSON-LD document
  model. Wrapping in a vector makes trailing second forms observable."
  [text]
  (try
    (let [forms (reader/read-string (str "[" text "\n]"))]
      (when-not (= 1 (count forms))
        (fail! :mithril.form/form-count "Mithril source must contain exactly one form"))
      (lower-form (first forms)))
    (catch :default error
      (if (:mithril/error (ex-data error))
        (throw error)
        (fail! :mithril.form/read-error (or (.-message error) "invalid Mithril form"))))))

(ns mithril.module
  "Check inert Mithril modules before lowering. No source evaluation or code emission."
  (:require [clojure.string :as str]
            [mithril.form :as form]))

(def ^:private max-depth 64)
(def ^:private max-nodes 4096)
(def ^:private max-functions 128)
(def ^:private max-exports 128)
(def ^:private max-params 64)
(def ^:private intrinsic-signatures
  {"add" {:params [:i64 :i64] :returns :i64}
   "sub" {:params [:i64 :i64] :returns :i64}
   "mul" {:params [:i64 :i64] :returns :i64}
   "eq" {:params [:scalar :scalar] :returns :bool}
   "not" {:params [:bool] :returns :bool}
   "js_nullish" {:params [:js-value] :returns :bool}
   "js_truthy" {:params [:js-value] :returns :bool}
   "js_strict_equal" {:params [:js-value :js-value] :returns :bool}
   "js_typeof" {:params [:js-value] :returns :string}
   "js_array" {:params [:js-value] :returns :bool}
   "js_bool_value" {:params [:bool] :returns :js-value}
   "js_undefined" {:params [] :returns :js-value}})

(defn- fail! [code detail]
  (throw (ex-info detail {:mithril/error code :detail detail})))

(defn- shape! [value fields]
  (when-not (and (map? value) (= (set fields) (set (keys value))))
    (fail! :mithril.module/invalid-shape "Unexpected or missing module fields")))

(defn- vector! [value limit]
  (when-not (vector? value)
    (fail! :mithril.module/invalid-shape "Module collections must be vectors"))
  (when (> (count value) limit)
    (fail! :mithril.module/budget "Module collection exceeds its budget")))

(defn- name! [value module?]
  (when-not (and (string? value)
                (re-matches (if module?
                              #"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*(?:\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)*"
                              #"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*") value))
    (fail! :mithril.module/invalid-name "Invalid module identifier"))
  value)

(defn- callable-type? [type]
  (and (vector? type) (= :fn (first type))))

(defn- type! [value]
  (let [nodes (atom 0)]
    (letfn [(check [value depth]
              (when (or (> depth 16) (> (swap! nodes inc) 64))
                (fail! :mithril.module/budget "Module type budget exceeded"))
              (if (map? value)
                (do (shape! value ["@type" "params" "returns"])
                    (when-not (= "FunctionType" (get value "@type"))
                      (fail! :mithril.module/unsupported-type "Expected a FunctionType"))
                    (let [params (get value "params")]
                      (vector! params 4)
                      [:fn [(mapv #(check % (inc depth)) params)
                            (check (get value "returns") (inc depth))]]))
                (or (get {"i64" :i64 "bool" :bool "string" :string "js-value" :js-value} value)
                    (fail! :mithril.module/unsupported-type "Unsupported module type"))))]
      (check value 1))))

(defn- unique! [values code]
  (when-not (= (count values) (count (set values)))
    (fail! code "Duplicate module declaration")))

(defn- i64! [value]
  ;; Decimal string comparison keeps every signed 64-bit boundary exact. Host
  ;; Numbers enter only when exactly representable; no Long/float coercion.
  (let [decimal (cond
                  (and (number? value) (js/Number.isSafeInteger value)) (str value)
                  (string? value) value
                  :else nil)]
    (when-not (and decimal (re-matches #"(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*|-[1-9][0-9]*)" decimal))
      (fail! :mithril.module/invalid-literal "Invalid canonical i64 literal"))
    (let [negative? (str/starts-with? decimal "-")
          digits (if negative? (subs decimal 1) decimal)
          bound (if negative? "9223372036854775808" "9223372036854775807")]
      (when (or (> (count digits) (count bound))
                (and (= (count digits) (count bound)) (pos? (compare digits bound))))
        (fail! :mithril.module/invalid-literal "i64 literal is outside signed bounds")))
    decimal))

(defn- literal! [datatype value]
  (case datatype
    :i64 (i64! value)
    :bool (if (boolean? value) value
            (fail! :mithril.module/invalid-literal "Expected a boolean literal"))
    :string (if (string? value) value
              (fail! :mithril.module/invalid-literal "Expected a string literal"))
    :js-value (fail! :mithril.module/invalid-literal
                    "Opaque host values cannot be module literals")
    (fail! :mithril.module/invalid-literal "Function values cannot be module literals")))

(defn- compatible-args? [identifier declared? expected actual]
  (if (and (not declared?) (= identifier "eq"))
    (and (apply = actual)
         (contains? #{:i64 :bool :string} (first actual)))
    (= expected actual)))

(defn- checked-params [params limit]
  (vector! params limit)
  (let [checked (mapv (fn [param]
                       (shape! param ["name" "datatype"])
                       {:name (name! (get param "name") false)
                        :type (type! (get param "datatype"))}) params)]
    (unique! (mapv :name checked) :mithril.module/duplicate-parameter)
    checked))

(defn- signature! [function]
  (shape! function ["@type" "name" "params" "returns" "body"])
  (when-not (= "Function" (get function "@type"))
    (fail! :mithril.module/invalid-shape "Expected a Function declaration"))
  {:name (name! (get function "name") false)
   :params (checked-params (get function "params") max-params)
   :returns (type! (get function "returns"))})

(defn- check-expression [expr signatures locals depth nodes calls]
  (when (or (> depth max-depth) (> (swap! nodes inc) max-nodes))
    (fail! :mithril.module/budget "Module expression budget exceeded"))
  (when-not (map? expr)
    (fail! :mithril.module/invalid-shape "Expected a module expression"))
  (case (get expr "@type")
    "Literal"
    (do (shape! expr ["@type" "datatype" "value"])
        (let [datatype (type! (get expr "datatype"))]
          {:op :literal :type datatype :value (literal! datatype (get expr "value"))}))
    "Local"
    (do (shape! expr ["@type" "name"])
        (let [identifier (name! (get expr "name") false)]
          (when-not (contains? locals identifier)
            (fail! :mithril.module/unknown-local "Unknown module local"))
          {:op :local :name identifier :type (get locals identifier)}))
    "Call"
    (do (shape! expr ["@type" "name" "args"])
        (let [identifier (name! (get expr "name") false)
              args (get expr "args")
              declared? (contains? signatures identifier)
              signature (if declared? (get signatures identifier)
                            (get intrinsic-signatures identifier))]
          ;; At most max-nodes arguments can fit the shared expression budget.
          (vector! args max-nodes)
          (when-not signature
            (fail! :mithril.module/unknown-call "Unknown module call"))
          (when-not (= (count args) (count (:params signature)))
            (fail! :mithril.module/arity "Module call arity mismatch"))
          (let [checked (mapv (fn [arg] (check-expression arg signatures locals (inc depth) nodes calls)) args)
                actual (mapv :type checked)
                expected (if declared? (mapv :type (:params signature)) (:params signature))]
            (when-not (compatible-args? identifier declared? expected actual)
              (fail! :mithril.module/type-mismatch "Module call type mismatch"))
            (when declared? (swap! calls conj identifier))
            {:op (if declared? :call :intrinsic) :name identifier
             :type (:returns signature) :args checked})))
    "Lambda"
    (do (shape! expr ["@type" "params" "returns" "body"])
        (let [params (checked-params (get expr "params") 4)
              returns (type! (get expr "returns"))
              env (into locals (map (juxt :name :type) params))
              body (check-expression (get expr "body") signatures env (inc depth) nodes calls)]
          (when-not (= returns (:type body))
            (fail! :mithril.module/type-mismatch "Module lambda return type mismatch"))
          {:op :lambda :params params :returns returns :body body
           :type [:fn [(mapv :type params) returns]]}))
    "FunctionRef"
    (do (shape! expr ["@type" "name"])
        (let [identifier (name! (get expr "name") false)
              signature (get signatures identifier)]
          (when-not signature
            (fail! :mithril.module/unknown-call "Unknown module function reference"))
          (when (> (count (:params signature)) 4)
            (fail! :mithril.module/budget "Function reference exceeds guest callable arity"))
          (swap! calls conj identifier)
          {:op :function-ref :name identifier
           :type [:fn [(mapv :type (:params signature)) (:returns signature)]]}))
    "Invoke"
    (do (shape! expr ["@type" "function" "args"])
        (let [callee (check-expression (get expr "function") signatures locals (inc depth) nodes calls)
              args (get expr "args")]
          (vector! args 4)
          (when-not (callable-type? (:type callee))
            (fail! :mithril.module/type-mismatch "Guest invocation requires a FunctionType"))
          (let [[expected returns] (second (:type callee))]
            (when-not (= (count expected) (count args))
              (fail! :mithril.module/arity "Guest invocation arity mismatch"))
            (let [checked (mapv #(check-expression % signatures locals (inc depth) nodes calls) args)]
              (when-not (= expected (mapv :type checked))
                (fail! :mithril.module/type-mismatch "Guest invocation argument type mismatch"))
              {:op :invoke :function callee :function-type (:type callee)
               :args checked :type returns}))))
    "Let"
    (do (shape! expr ["@type" "bindings" "body"])
        (let [bindings (get expr "bindings")]
          (vector! bindings max-nodes)
          (loop [remaining (seq bindings) env locals checked []]
            (if-let [binding (first remaining)]
              (do (shape! binding ["name" "value"])
                  (let [identifier (name! (get binding "name") false)
                        value (check-expression (get binding "value") signatures env (inc depth) nodes calls)]
                    (recur (next remaining) (assoc env identifier (:type value))
                           (conj checked {:name identifier :value value :type (:type value)}))))
              (let [body (check-expression (get expr "body") signatures env (inc depth) nodes calls)]
                {:op :let :bindings checked :body body :type (:type body)})))))
    "Sequence"
    (do (shape! expr ["@type" "expressions"])
        (let [expressions (get expr "expressions")]
          (vector! expressions max-nodes)
          (when (empty? expressions)
            (fail! :mithril.module/invalid-shape "Module sequence requires a result expression"))
          (let [checked (mapv #(check-expression % signatures locals (inc depth) nodes calls) expressions)]
            {:op :sequence :expressions checked :type (:type (peek checked))})))
    "If"
    (do (shape! expr ["@type" "condition" "then" "else"])
        (let [checked-condition (check-expression (get expr "condition") signatures locals (inc depth) nodes calls)
              checked-then (check-expression (get expr "then") signatures locals (inc depth) nodes calls)
              checked-else (check-expression (get expr "else") signatures locals (inc depth) nodes calls)]
          (when-not (= :bool (:type checked-condition))
            (fail! :mithril.module/type-mismatch "Module if condition type mismatch"))
          (when-not (= (:type checked-then) (:type checked-else))
            (fail! :mithril.module/type-mismatch "Module if branch type mismatch"))
          {:op :if :type (:type checked-then) :condition checked-condition
           :then checked-then :else checked-else}))
    (fail! :mithril.module/invalid-shape "Unknown module expression type")))

(defn- check-export [export]
  (if (map? export)
    (do (shape! export ["name" "function"])
        {:name (name! (get export "name") false)
         :target (name! (get export "function") false)})
    (let [name (name! export false)] {:name name :target name})))

(defn check-document
  "Validate all signatures, then bounded bodies, and return deterministic typed IR."
  [doc]
  (shape! doc ["@context" "@type" "name" "functions" "exports"])
  (when-not (and (= "Module" (get doc "@type"))
                (= "https://mithril.fund/context/module/v1" (get doc "@context")))
    (fail! :mithril.module/invalid-shape "Expected the module context and type"))
  (let [module-name (name! (get doc "name") true)
        functions (get doc "functions")
        exports (get doc "exports")]
    (vector! functions max-functions)
    (vector! exports max-exports)
    (let [declarations (mapv signature! functions)
          names (mapv :name declarations)]
      (unique! names :mithril.module/duplicate-function)
      (let [checked-exports (mapv check-export exports)
            public-names (mapv :name checked-exports)]
        (unique! public-names :mithril.module/duplicate-export)
      (let [signatures (zipmap names declarations)
            nodes (atom 0)
            graph (atom {})]
        (doseq [export checked-exports]
          (when-not (contains? signatures (:target export))
            (fail! :mithril.module/unknown-export "Unknown module export")))
        (let [checked (mapv
                        (fn [function declaration]
                          (let [locals (into {} (map (juxt :name :type) (:params declaration)))
                                calls (atom #{})
                                body (check-expression (get function "body") signatures locals 1 nodes calls)]
                            (when-not (= (:returns declaration) (:type body))
                              (fail! :mithril.module/type-mismatch "Module return type mismatch"))
                            (swap! graph assoc (:name declaration) (vec (sort @calls)))
                            (assoc declaration :body body))) functions declarations)]
          (cond-> {:format :mithril.module/checked-v1 :name module-name :exports public-names
                   :functions checked :call-graph @graph}
            (some map? exports)
            (assoc :export-targets (into {} (map (juxt :name :target) checked-exports))))))))))

(defn check-source-text!
  "Refuse oversized or excessively nested inert module source before Form parsing."
  [text]
  (when-not (string? text)
    (fail! :mithril.module/invalid-shape "Module text must be a string"))
  (when (> (count text) 262144)
    (fail! :mithril.module/budget "Module source exceeds its character budget"))
  ;; Refuse pathological nesting before the existing recursive Form lowering.
  ;; Strings, escaped quotes and line comments do not change structural depth.
  (loop [chars (seq text) depth 0 quoted? false escaped? false comment? false]
    (when-let [ch (first chars)]
      (cond
        comment? (recur (next chars) depth false false (not (= ch \newline)))
        quoted? (recur (next chars) depth (or escaped? (not (= ch \")))
                       (and (not escaped?) (= ch \\)) false)
        (= ch \;) (recur (next chars) depth false false true)
        (= ch \") (recur (next chars) depth true false false)
        (contains? #{\( \[ \{} ch)
        (let [nested (inc depth)]
          (when (> nested 140) (fail! :mithril.module/budget "Module source nesting exceeds its budget"))
          (recur (next chars) nested false false false))
        (contains? #{\) \] \}} ch) (recur (next chars) (dec depth) false false false)
        :else (recur (next chars) depth false false false)))))

(defn check-text [text]
  (check-source-text! text)
  (check-document (form/parse text)))
